title: Swim in Rising Water

monster.name: Tide Warden
monster.title: Commander of Inundation Levels
monster.defeatQuote: Least water level time required to reach bottom-right corner!

description: You are given an `n x n` integer matrix `grid` where each value `grid[i][j]` represents the elevation at that point. At time `t`, the depth of the water everywhere is `t`. You can swim from a square to an adjacent square if both are submerged (elevation <= t). You start at `(0, 0)`. Return the least time until you can reach `(n - 1, n - 1)`.
solutionCode:
def swimInWater(grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    n = len(grid)
    import heapq
    visited = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
    visited[0][0] = True
    pq = [(grid[0][0], 0, 0)]
    while pq:
        t, r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if r == n - 1 and c == n - 1: return t
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < n and not visited[nr][nc]:
                visited[nr][nc] = True
                heapq.heappush(pq, (max(t, grid[nr][nc]), nr, nc))
    return 0
